root_cause.text: The nouveau GSP-RM driver unnecessarily used `WARN_ON` macros to validate ACPI object types and buffer/package lengths returned by the platform firmware, leading to frequent kernel warnings on systems with unexpected but harmless ACPI configurations.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows the removal of `WARN_ON` wrappers from conditional checks in the `r535_gsp_acpi_caps`, `r535_gsp_acpi_jt`, and `r535_gsp_acpi_dod` functions (e.g., changing `WARN_ON(obj->type != ACPI_TYPE_BUFFER)` to `obj->type != ACPI_TYPE_BUFFER`) while keeping the underlying validation logic intact.
